title: Northbeam TechWorks Settlement Terms, Payment Methods and Liability Cap
content:
Four figures settle how a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair charge is paid and how far the retailer's own exposure runs: the days a business account may take to settle a service invoice, the ways service charges may be settled, the most the retailer will meet for damage caused during the work, and whether loan equipment is left while the item is away.

| TechWorks service | Days a business account may take to settle | Ways charges may be settled | Most met for damage caused during the work, USD | Loan equipment left while the item is away |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| TechWorks In Store Bench Service | 0 | card, cash or store credit at the counter | 1000.00 | no |
| TechWorks Standard Home Installation | 0 | card on file or store credit | 5000.00 | no |
| TechWorks Home Theatre Calibration | 0 | card on file or store credit | 10000.00 | yes |
| TechWorks Appliance Install and Haul Away | 0 | card on file or store credit | 7500.00 | no |
| TechWorks Business On Site Deployment | 30 | business invoice or bank transfer | 25000.00 | yes |
| TechWorks Managed IT Care Annual | 45 | business invoice or bank transfer | 50000.00 | yes |

### Reading the schedule

**Only the two business services carry settlement terms in days.** TechWorks Business On Site Deployment carries 30 days and TechWorks Managed IT Care Annual carries 45; the four consumer-facing services carry 0.

**The ways charges may be settled fall into three groups.** At the store counter, card, cash or store credit; on the three consumer services attended at an address, the card on file or store credit; on the two business services, the business invoice or a bank transfer.

**The damage figure rises with the value of what is being worked on**, from 1000.00 USD at the counter through 5000.00 on a standard home installation, 7500.00 on an appliance installation and 10000.00 on a calibration to 25000.00 on a business deployment and 50000.00 on the annual care service.

**Loan equipment is left under three services**: the calibration service, the business deployment service and the annual care service.
